bayts.text: The Real, the Manifest (Al-Ḥaqq al-Mubīn), has extended to me what appears to creation
and what does not appear to others than me, of glad tidings and favours.
I have preserved (by heart) His precious Remembrance, and He has bestowed on me (a gift) precious,
and my wish is not hard for the All-Powerful, the Bestower of favours (cf. Qurʾān 14:20).
The kingdom of Him to Whom existence belongs leads to me the most excellent bounty,
and for me has made the night vigils (of prayer) an answering with favours.
The kingdom of the Most High, the Everlasting, the Eternal, has made me the most radiant servant
of him to whom belongs an enduring merit, and has guarded me in (my) services.
My pens and the ink have called, to thank my Lord, an affection
for Him, and affection for him who is possessed of rectitude, our Prophet, the Foremost.
There yields to me, without end, from Him in Whom my journey has reached its end,
what my heart has desired, together with the good pleasure of the Possessor of eternity.
My Lord has sent sickness away toward others than my person, with the aim (fulfilled).
None who opposed with disputation and accusations has come against me;
no contender has come against me, for he contends with passion,
and for me my Lord draws out a remembrance that removes illusion.
My Lord has preserved His Remembrance through me, and I perpetuate gratitude to Him,
and for me He perpetuates His joy, with His hidden secret.
The blessing of the accepted Intercessor puts the cannon to shame,
and all that does not profit it has driven toward others than my aspirations.
He leads me toward the Gardens (al-jinān) Who has illumined my heart (al-janān),
(with) joy and clarity, with munificence, without harm or griefs.
The Real, the Manifest, has blessed me in what appears to His creatures
and in what appears to none but the Essence of the Bestower of favours.
